This system of Anunnaki control, where advanced physics transforms the environment instantaneously, operates much like a master sculptor who doesn't use tools but simply wills the clay to form itself perfectly. In contrast, the indigenous methods are specific: the stone-entities interact directly with the earth (geomantic), and the luminescent forms craft mental effects (consciousness-crafting), illustrating a fundamental difference in how power is applied and manifested.
